subject: NRI — sold flat in Bangalore, need help with TDS and capital gains
body_plain:
Dear Sir,

I am an NRI based in Dubai (OCI). I sold my flat in Bangalore last month for Rs 1.2 crores. The buyer deducted TDS at 20% but I believe it should be lower. I also need to file the ITR-2 for the capital gains.

Could you please advise on the process and fees? I can share Form 26AS.

Best regards,
Rajesh

subject: Setting up India subsidiary for US SaaS company
body_plain:
Hi,

We are Acme Tech, a Series B SaaS company in San Francisco. We want to set up a wholly-owned subsidiary in Bangalore to hire engineers. Do you help foreign companies with this kind of India entry? We'd also need ongoing payroll, tax, and HR compliance support.

How soon can we get on a call?

Sarah Chen
CFO, Acme Tech

subject: Transfer pricing study for FY25 — related party transactions
body_plain:
Dear Sir,

We are an Indian manufacturing company with significant related-party transactions with our UK parent. Our statutory auditor has flagged the need for a formal TP study and Form 3CEB report. Could you share your approach and typical timelines?

Regards,
Ajay Venkatesh
Finance Head, Sundara Industries

subject: Virtual CFO for seed-stage startup
body_plain:
Hi,

We are a 14-person seed-stage startup in Bangalore, planning to raise our Series A in 4-5 months. We currently do our accounts on Zoho. We need a part-time CFO to help with investor readiness, MIS, and financial modeling.

Do you offer this kind of engagement?

Thanks,
Priya

subject: Legal notice from Income Tax — Section 148 scrutiny
body_plain:
Dear Sir, I received a legal notice from the Income Tax Department under Section 148 for reassessment of AY22. They are alleging unreported income of Rs 80 lakhs. I need urgent help.

Regards
